clock_domain_crossings.policy: report all HF/LF/JTAG crossings and review synchronizer inputs, handshakes and resets individually

generated_clock_policy.default: 150MHz conservative pulse envelope; no register cases
generated_clock_policy.gates: latch+AND clock propagation and clock-gating checks remain enabled
generated_clock_policy.pll: actual RTL assign-through; no analog PLL claim

io_contract.note: Not official board/pad/SRAM timing qualification; no async reset-release guarantee

lf_clock_scope.note: AON boot/deglitch/reset delay changes; actual twelve-task window comparison is required, not inferred from this unit test

pending: real DC/PT execution and mapped selector/clock coverage audit
setup, hold, recovery, removal, gating and minimum pulse-width closure
all untested paths and HF/LF/JTAG CDC/reset review
32.768kHz actual full-SoC startup and measured task-window replay
official external I/O timing and same-corner SRAM PVT/EMA timing eligibility

reset_exceptions.recovery_removal: retained; async external release/CDC must be reviewed; no blanket waiver

clock_review.review_scope: source-derived digital constraints and local lightweight checks only

sdc_mock.scope: Tcl syntax and control flow with mock collections; no DC/PT selector, timing, or library validation

clock_review.untested_check_policy: retain check_timing + PT analysis coverage, endpoint clocks, SRAM CLK clocks, recovery/removal/gating/pulse-width and all command failures; every untested check requires explicit classification

implementation.note: Actual s3-pe64 full-digital-SoC development configuration, exact 384 RAMSP1024X16 macros. PE64 uses one64-bank W array: 32768 logical bytes, 131072 physical bytes, 98304 padding bytes. Mapping/PVT/netlist equivalence are unreviewed; no timing, power, or contest pass claimed. No vendor simulation models are in the synthesis source list.

clocks.pll: e203_subsys_pll assigns reference through; no physical analog PLL model

gaps: 512 KiB shared RAM exists only in TB; synthesize an explicit RAM+ICB endpoint in a full-scope top
ITCM/DTCM behavioral arrays need qualified SRAM mappings with byte writes and synchronous read semantics
TB task preload/scoreboard/HOST is not synthesizable hardware and must stay outside the PPA top
Register/FIFO/debug/bias/X storage still costs standard cells unless separately mapped; do not count as zero
Fixed clock/reset/gating topology needs full-SoC clocks, generated clocks, exceptions and analysis-coverage review
Wrapper-only VCD cannot measure CPU/interconnect/shared SRAM energy
Mapped gate/SRAM functional equivalence and twelve-task full-scope activity remain required

accelerator_weights.implementation: 64 banks, one mem_1024x16 each; upper768 rows per macro unreachable

shared.response: one outstanding; response held until accepted; cmd_ready additionally cycles%7!=0
shared.write_behavior: TB accepts only fullword Y writes; HOST status writes handled by scoreboard
